div.div: Massachusetts General Hospital, a founding member of Mass General Brigham, is a teaching hospital of Harvard Medical School. As a leading world-class academic medical center, we provide advanced medical care based on innovative research and clinical trials.

p.a: The image shows the exterior of a large, modern hospital complex with multiple high-rise buildings. The main entrance is clearly marked, and several people and vehicles are visible in front of the entrance area.

div.h2: Dedicated to innovation and clinical excellence

div.p: At Massachusetts General Hospital, a founding member of Mass General Brigham, we are committed to providing the highest quality and safest care possible for every patient—near and far.

Home to the largest hospital-based research enterprise in the U.S., we foster a culture of collaboration and education, pushing the boundaries of medical research and maintaining an unwavering commitment to the diverse communities we serve.

Our expert clinicians are leaders in their medical fields and handle the most complex cases. Today, patients from around New England—and across the globe—trust us for their medical care. U.S. News & World Report ranks Mass General among the top 10 nationwide in psychiatry; ophthalmology*; cancer; rheumatology; diabetes/endocrinology; cardiology/heart surgery; and obstetrics/gynecology.

p.em: * In partnership with Mass Eye and Ear.

div.a: Two male doctors in white lab coats are examining detailed brain MRI images displayed on a computer monitor.

div.h2: Patients and visitors of Mass General

div.div: Here are some helpful resources for patients, families, and visitors.

div.p: Our nearly 4,000 doctors provide outstanding care across dozens of specialties.
In addition to our main campus, we have locations across Greater Boston and beyond.
Communicate with your care team, review medications, pay medical bills, and more.
Review Mass General visitor policies, dining options, and more.

div.div: Mass General offers a full range of clinical services and programs for common and complex medical conditions across 30 institutes, centers and departments.

img.alt: US News & World Report Best Hospitals Honor Roll badge

div.h2: Mass General recognized as a U.S. News Honor Roll hospital

div.div: Once again named among the top hospitals in the nation, Mass General is also ranked #1 for Psychiatry, and top 10 for Cancer; Cardiology, Heart & Vascular Surgery; Diabetes & Endocrinology; Obstetrics & Gynecology; Ophthalmology (with Mass Eye and Ear); and Rheumatology (2026-27).

div.a: Doctor and patient standing together indoors.
Scientist working with laboratory equipment and tubing.

div.div: In the delivery of our care, through our research and within our communities, Massachusetts General Hospital is committed to the well-being of our patients locally and globally. As a teaching hospital of Harvard Medical School, we train the next generation of leaders in science and medicine.

div.h2: Young adult with congenital heart disease has completed three marathons… and counting

div.div: Read how Alexa, born with Tetralogy of Fallot, thrives today as a nurse and marathon runner thanks to adult congenital heart disease care.

div.a: Runners participating in city road race.

div.h2: Massachusetts General Hospital clinical trials and research

div.div: As a leading academic medical center, Massachusetts General Hospital advances medical research with the goal of improving diagnosis and treatment. Our investigators are engaged in research from the laboratory through clinical trials, translating discoveries into new therapies, diagnostics, and care approaches that expand treatment options for our patients.

div.a: Scientist working in laboratory with pipette equipment.

div.h6: Find Massachusetts General Hospital clinical trials

div.h2: Partner with us in pushing the boundaries of what's possible

div.div: Your support helps Mass General to deliver the highest-quality patient care, pursue the most innovative and promising research, and train the brightest medical minds to become tomorrow's healthcare leaders.

div.a: An elderly woman lies in a hospital bed, wearing a patterned gown, while a healthcare worker sits beside her, holding her hand.

div.h2: Learn more about Massachusetts General Hospital

p.a: Phillip and Susan Ragon Building Project

div.div: Helpful, compassionate Massachusetts General Hospital care coordinators are just a call away to help guide your care, answer questions, schedule appointments, and plan your visit.
